title: Prometheus alerts from scoped SLO brief
objective: Measure whether the alert-rules craftbook scopes symptom alerts before writing deployable, low-noise alerting YAML.
prompt: In the `Alert Rules Eval` project, read `source/slo-brief.md` and write `alerts.yaml` as Prometheus-style alerting rules. Scope the signals and noise budget first, then produce YAML with groups, alert names, expr, for, severity/routing labels, summaries, descriptions, and runbook_url annotations for page alerts.

setup.missionObjectives: Produce low-noise alerting rules from the seeded SLO brief with symptom signals, thresholds, severities, runbook links, and routing labels.

files.content:
# Alert scope brief

Service: Harbor Payments checkout-api and webhook-worker.

SLOs:
- Checkout p99 latency should stay below 800 ms over 10 minutes.
- Checkout 5xx error rate should stay below 2% over 5 minutes.
- Webhook retry backlog should stay below 5,000 jobs for more than 10 minutes.

Routing:
- page severity routes to team=payments, service=checkout-api or webhook-worker.
- ticket severity routes to team=payments during business hours.
- Page-level noise budget: no more than two page alerts.
- Required runbooks: https://runbooks.example/payments/checkout-latency, https://runbooks.example/payments/checkout-errors, https://runbooks.example/payments/webhook-backlog.

success.summary: workspace/alerts.yaml is a Prometheus-style rule file with scoped symptom signals, thresholds, severities, routing, runbook annotations, and noise-budget evidence.

checks.label: checkout latency alert uses a p99 signal
webhook backlog alert uses retry backlog threshold
avoid raw infrastructure cause alerts not present in the SLO brief
